title: Classify all maximal irreducible binary edge pools (no κ)
body:
## Result and scope

**Every irreducible binary noncoordinate projector collection with pattern dimension `k>=2` and image dimension `2k-1` is automatically complete and has one edge-pair-and-link form.** Its pattern space contains exactly `k-1` disjoint matrix-unit edges. The pool consists of their two lifts each and one link `(h_x+a)(h_y+b)^T`, with fixed old-coordinate factors and arbitrary fresh factors satisfying `a dot b=1`. These conditions are also sufficient at every ambient width.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab13e010216570a00e22490b379b31b610f2890/research/edge-extremal-pool-classification/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab13e010216570a00e22490b379b31b610f2890/research/edge-extremal-pool-classification/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab13e010216570a00e22490b379b31b610f2890/research/edge-extremal-pool-classification/verify.py) and [scope record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab13e010216570a00e22490b379b31b610f2890/research/edge-extremal-pool-classification/TASK.json). Every restricted action is isomorphic to the first `2k-2` coordinate projectors plus the all-one matrix of size `2k-1`. This extends the prior k=3 two-edge restricted normal form and removes the initial edge-count and completeness premises. The proof first forces the edges through the matching bound, excludes the pure-unit boundary through its directed graph, then proves that the added pattern coset has exactly one ambient projector.

The parameterization is up to coordinate permutation. It is not an ambient orbit count, and the normal-form shear is not a free physical operation. **No new kappa**, paid BIT word, native operator or complete invoice is supplied. The selected frontier and all five assumptions remain unchanged. This completes the [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19706288).

## Evidence and reproduction

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.16 replay passed on macOS arm64. The verifier checks all 2825 pattern spaces at width three and all 4164 directed unit graphs at widths two through four. Separate raw scans and literal-pattern lifts agree on complete pools. The image-orbit irreducibility test agrees with direct closure of every nonzero image vector in the width-three census.

Seven complete added-coset domains contain 30702 spaces, counted within the stated domains. Exactly 49 are irreducible, all in the claimed form; 1351 direct nonzero-vector orbit checks confirm them. Every negative has a checked common-kernel or proper image-orbit certificate. The domains include 352 pools with extra members, with up to nine members. Twenty-four wider forms through width 19 pass complete-pool and restriction-matrix checks over 2776 nonzero patterns, including nonsymmetric fresh supports. Explicit controls show why k=1 and reducible collections do not satisfy the theorem.

Metadata, committed bytes, modes, source ancestry, eight-file export and archive integrity pass. A read-only optimized export replay passes without Git or a usable PATH; all nine payload/manifest hashes and modes stay unchanged.

With CPython 3.12 and its standard library, from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/edge-extremal-pool-classification/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B -O research/edge-extremal-pool-classification/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/edge-extremal-pool-classification
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/edge-extremal-pool-classification --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers:

```text
PASS_EDGE_EXTREMAL_POOL_CLASSIFICATION
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

The all-width proof uses the pinned matching theorem below. The finite scans do not cover every ambient embedding. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44286238065/job/134739523942) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. Full predecessor package replays, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Sources and credit

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Ali Romman's [PR #7692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7692), [exact proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c2870a38841f515db7203a0761cd77f014f7fb7a/research/edge-matching-image-bound/PROOF.md), supplies the all-width matching bound and positive family. Matrix, basis, lift, orbit and subspace routines are reused from its [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c2870a38841f515db7203a0761cd77f014f7fb7a/research/edge-matching-image-bound/verify.py). Its source record retains the disjoint-relation and support lineage of [PR #7690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7690) and [PR #7691](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7691).

@CubeJerry supplied the k=3 two-edge normal form and common cross-block argument in [PR #6782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6782), [exact proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/685457252b51b9c7932ece363365bdf0b12c9c31/research/bit-three-relation-core/PROOF.md). That source credits Nick Petalas's [PR #5921](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5921) for the edge fibers. The known five-dimensional restricted action and the existing all-k positive family remain prior work. [Credit details](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab13e010216570a00e22490b379b31b610f2890/research/edge-extremal-pool-classification/CREDITS.md) separate the new necessity/completeness theorem from those inputs. New work is Apache-2.0.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Card `bit-new-register-model`, scope changed to the universal extremal classification; the native construction gate remains unmet. Refreshed open/closed PR and Discussion overlap and live handoffs show no competing all-k classification claim. Sparse local and unpublished work remain coverage limits. Scalar geometry work on this extremal family stops here. Further construction must compare the existing five-core word obstruction and specify the legal alphabet, relation lattice, endpoint basis, counted roles and complete native invoice.
